jobs.name: 血小板修补塔
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for the existing pixel-art biological tower-defense game 胞卫战. Use attached existing tower icons as STYLE references only; create a new unique tower identity. Strict overhead orthographic view, flat 2D hand-clustered PIXEL ART with visible square pixels and stair-step silhouette. Readable at 64 px gameplay size; approximately 80-96 logical pixel detail across the subject, uniformly sized pixel clusters, limited 18-24 color palette, crisp hard edges, no antialiasing, no soft gradients, no 3D or isometric depth. Fully transparent background, one centered compact silhouette filling 75-80% of a square canvas with generous transparent padding on every side. No lettering, labels, UI frame, ground, cast shadow, weapons or machinery, no faces or eyes. Friendly microscopic biological shapes with ivory highlights, cyan friendly-team accents, dark muted plum/brown outline (not black). Subject: PLATELET REPAIR TOWER, a compact activated platelet aggregate that helps mend nearby fibrin barriers. A large softly irregular warm peach-apricot central platelet disk, TWO smaller overlapping flattened platelet disks connected into its lower-left and upper-right edges. Neither cell nuclei nor a central blue nucleus: platelets are cell fragments; use small honey/rose secretory granules scattered in the peach cytoplasm. Four short blunt ivory/cyan pseudopods around the aggregate, not spikes. Two short paired pale mint fibrin threads bridge between the disks and form a tidy woven repair seam across the central disk, ending within the compact silhouette. Distinct peach and pale mint identity that reads as biological repair and adhesion, no medical cross symbol, no fabric sewing needle. Flat crisp pixel clusters in exactly the visual family of the references.

jobs.name: 补体裂解塔
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for the existing pixel-art biological tower-defense game 胞卫战. Use attached existing tower icons as STYLE references only; create a new unique tower identity. Strict overhead orthographic view, flat 2D hand-clustered PIXEL ART with visible square pixels and stair-step silhouette. Readable at 64 px gameplay size; approximately 80-96 logical pixel detail across the subject, uniformly sized pixel clusters, limited 18-24 color palette, crisp hard edges, no antialiasing, no soft gradients, no 3D or isometric depth. Fully transparent background, one centered compact silhouette filling 75-80% of a square canvas with generous transparent padding on every side. No lettering, labels, UI frame, ground, cast shadow, weapons or machinery, no faces or eyes. Friendly microscopic biological shapes with ivory highlights, cyan friendly-team accents, dark muted plum/brown outline (not black). Subject: COMPLEMENT LYSIS TOWER represented by a biological PROTEIN COMPLEX, not a nucleated cell. A compact nearly circular crown of TWELVE chunky cyan/teal protein segments assembling into a membrane-attack pore, ivory rim highlights and deep teal inner edges. The center is an EMPTY visibly transparent hole about one quarter of the whole object's diameter: clearly show a porous protein ring, no nucleus, no gem, no yellow disk at the center. One small gap at upper right separates the last two segments, bridged by TWO small pale gold connector protein nodules attached closely to the ring; no detached particles outside. Three tiny flat mint scaffold lobes attached at lower edge integrate into the ring silhouette. Smooth biological rounded subunits drawn as square pixel clusters, no metal gear teeth, no mechanical bolts, no magic rune. Cyan/teal and restrained honey connector accents express gradual protein assembly and single-target lysis. Distinct from the existing fibrin mesh icon: no mesh or crossing threads across the empty central pore.
